en.html:
No increase in speed.
No response when I tried to turn.

That last exchange... I had forced this unfit body into a full attack—was this the result?
Now, at the crucial moment............the heat!!

Was this the enemy’s plan?
Hold back its trump card until I had exhausted myself, then shoot me down!?

My own bloody carelessness!
